messages.build.pageMismatchLenient: . Fix it and run again, or pass --lenient to follow the report page order (pages without script text show as empty).
messages.build.scriptDuplicateField: Page {page} repeats the "{field}" field (lines {lines}); the last value wins.
messages.build.scriptUnknownField: Line {line} on page {page}: "{field}" is not a recognized field name, so this text is kept as body text. {known}
messages.build.scriptBadDuration: The duration "{text}" on page {page} cannot be read, so it counts as 0 seconds. Write "N min", "N seconds" and so on.
messages.export.badFormat: Not recognized: neither JSON nor annotation Markdown. New exports start with a format marker (annotation-everything export v1 lang=…); the older Chinese export (## Page N｜…) has no marker and still reads.
